description: Applies a target PWM carrier frequency from a config value at runtime (bounded, apply-on-change). The control ISR rate follows the carrier; integrating nodes must use platform_get_pwm_dt().

inputPorts.name: TargetHz
inputPorts.description: Target carrier frequency in hertz (clamped to MinHz..MaxHz).

outputPorts.name: AppliedHz
outputPorts.description: Currently applied carrier frequency in hertz.

Applied.description: Persistent last-applied frequency state (leave at default).
